title: Lender-Placed Flood Master Programs — Loan-Event Schedule and the Lender's Loan-Event Cancellation
content:
**Lender-Placed Flood Master Programs — certificates ended by an event on the loan itself.**

**Scope.** For a loan event that the lender reports on the day it takes effect, on the certificate most recently issued under the program, and only for such an event, the loan-event credit is figured by this loan-event schedule; any other loan-event cancellation keeps the base treatment, under which the credit is the annual premium multiplied by the days from the cancellation effective date to the certificate expiration date divided by the days in the certificate term, rounded to the cent.

**When the credit is fixed.**

> The loan-event credit is fixed only after the loan carries a certificate issued on or after its latest first notice, once that notice's borrower notice period has run with no acceptable borrower evidence received since that notice.

**What the cancellation books.** The certificate is cancelled for the stated loan event on the effective date given, and the unearned-premium credit is booked to the program account on the statement for the current month, linked to the cancellation entry; the amount the lender owes on the program falls by the credit.

## The lender's own tool: `cancel_certificate_for_loan_event_5b69d826`

The lender, as holder of the master policy, ends the coverage itself: the agent unlocks `cancel_certificate_for_loan_event_5b69d826` and hands it over, and the customer themselves runs it.

| Parameter | Meaning | Format or values |
|---|---|---|
| `forceplaced_program_id` | Reference number of the master program the certificate sits under, from the master program lookup | Identifier |
| `certificate_number` | Certificate number exactly as shown on the certificate's issue or renewal entry | Verbatim text |
| `loan_number` | The lender's loan number exactly as shown on that certificate's entries | Verbatim text |
| `loan_event` | The loan event ending the coverage | Exactly one of `LOAN_PAID_OFF` (the loan was paid in full), `SERVICING_TRANSFERRED` (servicing moved to another servicer), `REMOVED_FROM_SFHA` (a FEMA Letter of Map Amendment or Revision took the building out of the Special Flood Hazard Area) |
| `cancellation_effective_date` | Date certificate coverage ends | YYYY-MM-DD |
| `credit_amount` | Unearned-premium credit returned to the lender | Non-negative USD amount with 2 decimals, rounded half to even to the cent on booking |

**Return.** A confirmation naming the cancellation entry reference, the certificate number, the reason, the cancellation effective date, the credit booked with its statement month (YYYY-MM), the credit entry reference, and the program's amount owed net of the credit (a negative figure is a credit balance due to the lender). Both references indicate the certificate was cancelled and credited.
